The published table prints Power Supply 380 V; Motor Power 7.5/9 kW; Drive All copper dual motor; Output Capacity 3–5 m³/h; Max. Particle Size ≤5 mm; Sand-Cement Ratio ≤1:3; Dimensions (L×W×H) 1700 × 650 × 800 mm; Main Unit Weight 360 kg.
